ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only an action
   B. Only a describing word
   C. A person, place, thing, or idea
   D. Only a joining word

2. When practising Connected text and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text and fluency.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Connected text and fluency.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text and fluency.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Connected text and fluency.

3. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.

4. When practising Language School, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Language School.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language School.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Language School.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Language School.

5. When practising Pre-Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre-Writing.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Pre-Writing.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Pre-Writing.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Pre-Writing.

6. When practising Word Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Word Reading.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Word Reading.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Word Reading.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.

7. When practising Phonics, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonics.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Phonics.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Phonics.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Phonics.

8. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the Library
   B. Where is the library
   C. where is the library
   D. Where is the library?

9. When practising Language Welcome and, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Language Welcome and.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Language Welcome and.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Welcome and.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Language Welcome and.

10. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. run
   B. quickly
   C. blue
   D. happiness

11. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.

12. When practising Pre Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Pre Reading.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Pre Reading.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre Reading.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Pre Reading.

13. When practising Attentive listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive listening.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Attentive listening.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Attentive listening.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive listening.

14. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. goed
   B. going
   C. goes
   D. went

15. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. Only one word repeated
   B. Many unrelated topics with no link
   C. One main idea with supporting sentences
   D. No full stops

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Language School and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Pre Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Phonics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Word Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Connected text and fluency and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Pre-Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Handwriting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
